# _Meet AI Editor:_ Make Quick Page Updates in Plain English

Businesses often go through small changes and updates. A phone number gets updated. A team member shifts roles. A new service area opens up. These updates are simple, but they still matter. When buyers land on your website, the details they see should reflect the business they’re speaking to today.

Until today, the workflow has been simple. Customers would send updates to our team, and we'd handle them. It worked, but it added a wait for what should be a 30-second change.

That's why we built the **AI Editor**.

## Edit any page by describing the change

Starting today, every Gushwork customer can update their landing pages directly from the dashboard using plain English prompts. You describe the change. The editor handles the rest.

_Your number changed from 555-xxx to 555-yyy?_ Type it into the editor. It updates everywhere the old number appears.

_You want to rename "HVAC services in Chicago" to "Fast and same-day HVAC services in Chicago"?_ Open that page, describe the change, done.

_You just earned a new certification you want to showcase?_ Tell the editor what it is. It updates the credential across every page it belongs on.

Type the update in plain English, review the suggested edit, and publish it when it looks right. And if something looks off, there's a one-click revert.

Every edit you make is stored as context. When new pages get created for you, they show up with your latest reality. You don't have to repeat yourself.

Also, all your edits run through the same SEO and AEO principles we use to build your pages in the first place. If a requested change would hurt your rankings or AI visibility, the editor will flag it before you publish and tell you why. You stay in control, but you don't have to be an SEO expert to make a safe edit.

## Available now for Gushwork customers

AI Editor is now live inside the Gushwork dashboard.

Open AI Editor, type the update you want, review the suggested change, and publish when ready.

If you are already a Gushwork customer, you can [start using it today](https://platform.gushwork.ai/).
